text:
By Erica Radol ,
4 hours ago

Luxe skincare, but make it pharmacy pricing.
That’s what fans say about RoC’s Line Smoothing daily cleansing pads , which promise to reduce fine lines and dark spots while making skin smoother and brighter, even for sensitive skin.
And, in the last hours of Amazon’s October Prime Day , which ends tonight — not only are they on sale for just $12 — if you add two to your cart, one will be 50% off, making the total under $20.
Last hours to shop these 59 Prime Day deals on celeb-loved beauty and skincare
RoC Line Smoothing Daily Cleansing Pad RoC
BUY NOW $14.99 $11.97 The two-sided pads have a soft side for delicate areas like the eyes (yes, they even work on eye makeup!), and the other side is textured to thoroughly clean pores.
They have a combination of glycerin to hydrate skin and phyto-proteins that help diminish wrinkles, making your cleansing routine an anti-aging treat.
Perfumes are pricey, but until tonight, you can grab these ones up to 35% off
So many celebs, from Sarah Jessica Parker to Bethenny Frankel, have expressed their love of the French pharmacy brand. But this author especially loves these easy-to-use cleansing pads for their efficacy and gentleness. My skin is reactive, so sometimes I use them every other day if it’s feeling stressed.
I stocked up at one point and still have the older packaging. Erica Radol One five-star review among the 10,000+ on Amazon reads, “After just a few uses, my skin feels incredibly smooth and looks so much brighter. They’ve really helped with my skin’s texture. I love that they’re hypoallergenic and easy to use on the go. They live up to the RoC name, and I’m totally hooked.”

There are a few other RoC products I swear by, including the Parker-approved RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing eye cream . A lot of the products are deeply discounted during October Prime Days, making it easy to pick up a few months’ supply, or more.
They also make incredible SPF-packed day creams, as all of their products are real multi-taskers, cutting my skincare regimen steps down. (As a minimalist at heart, I appreciate that.)
RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing Eye Cream RoC
BUY NOW $29.99 $21.97 With Amazon’s excellent return policy, it’s easy enough to send back, should they not be for you, but the likelihood is you will love them as much as I do.
Scoop them up before the sale ends in a few hours!
